title: Thor layout and menu fixes
summary: Restore lower-screen Guild paging and Close, add dedicated Kingdom tabs, group Settings menus, and improve text contrast, wrapping and spacing across Adventure, Hero, Town, Tavern and dialogs.
preparation: Install the checksum-verified is.xyz.vcmi.thor candidate. Use a disposable save with a multi-page scenario event, two or more heroes and towns, and access to a Tavern and Mage Guild. Start at default display and font sizing.
limitations: The candidate fixes the panels covered by the original audit. Check physical text readability and touch accuracy on both displays.

checks.title: Thieves’ Guild return and paging
checks.steps: Open Tavern, switch to Rumor, then open Thieves’ Guild. Page to the last page and back, compare the displayed ties against the upper screen, then tap lower Close. Repeat from the upper Guild button and close on the upper screen.
checks.expected: Both inputs restore Tavern on its prior tab. Pages use one valid page counter, respect their boundaries and agree with the upper screen. Opening a different Tavern starts on Heroes.

checks.title: Kingdom and Hero layouts
checks.steps: From Adventure Actions open Kingdom and switch Heroes and Towns from each screen. Select and open each kind of row, then close it. In Hero, switch Overview, Army and Artifacts; use an empty destination and artifact paging in a disposable save.
checks.expected: The visible tab matches the upper window and remains selected after a child closes. Buttons, lists, help and pagination have separate areas. Overview shows clean primary-stat names and values.

checks.title: Settings order and warnings
checks.steps: Open Settings on the upper screen. Enter each lower category, page its preferences, inspect Interface Scaling and Spellbook animation, and page to Game session. Open Load Game, Main Menu and Restart prompts and decline each. Check Save and Back.
checks.expected: Category choices, preferences and session actions have separate pages. Back has one persistent control. Setting names and their current values are readable. Warning text stays clear of the divider, and decline follows the native parent behavior.

checks.title: Adventure, Town and journal legibility
checks.steps: Review Adventure Actions and Map in Fit, Detail and Plan; inspect a marker and preview then cancel a route. Read a multi-page Event, return to List, and close. Check Town Army, Tavern Details and Rumor, and disabled controls in Town Services and Save.
checks.expected: Tabs, text and rows do not collide. Body text wraps at words where possible and all event text remains accessible. Disabled and empty states are readable and disabled controls remain inert.

checks.title: Window and display transitions
checks.steps: Rapidly page and close Guild and Kingdom, background/resume in each, and toggle or reconnect the lower display. Exercise a battle result and verify upper touch/controller navigation and single-display fallback.
checks.expected: Only the current owner and revision receive input. Battle Results page and close through native actions. Reattached display reflects the current upper window, and upper touch/controller behavior stays usable.
